held.rip.why: declared-but-uninstalled: gradual holds it with the install remedy; strict publishes the unresolved module
the host floor: gradual supplies `declare module "bun:*"`; strict refuses every floor
the implicit-any family: code-suppressed in gradual, published in strict
the missing-types family: gradual counts it as an advisory, strict publishes the missing declarations
inference-only reach: no annotation reaches the line, so the gate holds it; strict checks everything
scaffolding: the bang-def's face `: void` is emitter output and opens nothing in gradual; strict still asks for the parameter's type
the null family: the line is reached in gradual (it is annotated) and held by posture, not by the gate
catch bindings: reached scope, held by posture (useUnknownInCatchVariables) — the family TypeScript 7 turned on by default
object-literal `this` under strict makes the member read circular; gradual's loose base types `this` as `any`
the same method's member read against the literal type strict gives `this`

published.rip.why: always-reported: an unresolvable module no one declared is a defect in every mode
always-reported: a free name is a defect in every mode
always-reported: the did-you-mean misspelling family publishes in gradual
reach by annotation: the author wrote a type, so the violation publishes
reach by flow: the annotated type moves along assignment to the alias
reach by construction: models are compiler-typed, and the scope filters a column the schema never declared — anchored on the schema head
